courseTitle: 100 Days of Code: JavaScript Data Structures and Algorithms

lectures.title: Time and Space Complexity of Stack using Linked List

cues.en: Now in this lecture, we are going to look at the big picture of the time and space complexity of stack
methods using linked lists.
So it's obvious that when we are creating the stack we are creating an empty stack.
So that's why the creation of the stack is going to be a one time complexity.
And we are going to create an empty stack.
That's why the space complexity is going to be zero one.
Now when it comes to the push method, adding an element to the top of the stack is always a constant
time operation, since it involves setting a couple of pointers.
And space complex is also zero one because creating a new node takes constant space.
Now the next method is pop method, so removing the top element from the stack is a constant time operation,
and when we are removing it, an additional memory is not required.
That's why the space complexity is o one.
Then pick method.
So we know that pick method retrieves the top elements from the stack without removing it, and this
will take one time complexity and space complexity is also o one.
Now when it comes to the Isempty method, we are just checking that if the stack is empty by using the
Len property.
So that's why it's going to be a one time complexity.
And the space complexity is also O one.
So the last method is clear method.
With clear method we are just setting the top to null and Len to zero, which are constant operations.
That's why the time complexity is o one.
And when it comes to the space complexity, an additional memory is not reused over here.
That's why the space complexity is O one.
This operation will allow all nodes to be garbage collected, which eventually releases space proportional
to the number of the elements that were in the stack.
But the complexity of the freeing memory is not typically counted for in space complexity analysis.
That's why the space complexity is O one.
Overall, the time complexity for all methods in stack using linked list is going to be O one.
So this is the main advantage of creating a stack using linked list.
So hopefully everything is clear.
